'''Dep Aila''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. He was the first scientist to document the [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] known as the [[barbed ginx]], though he only encountered them by accident&mdash;after leaving his [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] unattended, he came back to find a small group of ginx had peeled off the vehicle's outer casing in search of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dep Aila was mentioned in the Codex entry for the barbed ginx in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion released for the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
